title: 田間易學·卷五 (vol 7)
shelf_note: Qian Chengzhi's Tianjian Yixue, Siku Quanshu manuscript copy (欽定四庫全書 in the frame); a Yijing commentary belongs in the Universal Library Chinese set.
structure_note: 162 pages, all OCR'd, 154 translated. Only 13 printed numbers detected, so the 3 backsteps and 2 repeats are more likely misread folio marks in the frame than a broken order; the three pages here run in sequence (益 hexagram, 初九 to 六二).

title: Summa Angelica de casibus conscientie
shelf_note: Angelo Carletti's Summa Angelica (Koberger 1498, BSB), a major casuistry manual, here the article Usura I. No collection is assigned (catalog_metadata.collections empty), so it sits on no shelf.
structure_note: 545 pages, 540 translated. Only 42 printed numbers detected, with 14 backsteps and 15 repeats: the book is foliated on rectos only, and the OCR tags header words as page numbers (p.526 <page-num>i.</page-num>, which is the 'Usura.i.' header), so the counts are noise, not a broken order. The three pages run in sequence (CCXLIX r, v, CCL r).

book_verdict: Usable but error-prone. On a dense, heavily abbreviated incunable the OCR misreads key abbreviations: a rate (sex → fer.), authorities (Ho. → Io., tex. est clarus → 'Clarus'), and condition clauses. The translation carries these into fluent English and adds misattributed authorities and model-supplied citation numbers. On p.527 the opening question and the antidota rule are reversed in sense.

title: Kabbala denudata, seu, doctrina Hebraeorum transcendentalis et metaphysica atque theologica ...
shelf_note: Knorr von Rosenroth's Kabbala denudata (e-rara), here the Latin version of Herrera's Porta Coelorum ('Philosophia Cabbalistica', Dissertatio II cap.1) on Adam Kadmon as the first Principiatum. Core Kabbalah, though no collection is assigned.
structure_note: 2547 pages, 2545 OCR'd, 2494/2526 translated (the field and the count disagree slightly). The 1693 printed repeats and 69 backsteps fit a multi-part work in which each treatise restarts its pagination; they do not point to a splice. Pages 36-37-38 run in order here.

ocr_errors.problem: long-s read as f; the translation keeps the misspelt 'Brefchith' for Bereshit

ocr_errors.image: no signature visible at the foot (only show-through)
ocr_errors.problem: invented signature mark

tr_errors.english: the King above the King of Kings
tr_errors.problem: the plural is lost ('King over the Kings of Kings')

other.note: six '<note>original: "…"</note>' echoes (Lorja, Sohar, Brefchith, Tikkunim, ben Jochai, Adam Kadmon) clutter the paragraph

book_verdict: Clean: the OCR is near-perfect apart from long-s, and the translation is faithful. Its only blemish is repetitive '<note>original: …</note>' clutter.
